name: HealthStack
description: A reference healthcare data platform demonstrating clinical data ingestion, FHIR interoperability, transformation, OMOP CDM integration, orchestration, storage, and API access using a modular, cloud-agnostic architecture.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @healthstack/logger && npm run build -w @healthstack/audit
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @healthstack/api
scripts.synthea: npm run synthea:build && npm run synthea:run
